fields.summary_ko.0: SNDK declined 2% in after-hours trading on TrendForce's 2027 NAND flash weakness outlook; Q4 2026 price increase expectations were reduced to 8–13%.
fields.summary_ko.1: SNDK surged 2,445% since the start of the year, though a significant decline in enterprise SSD orders from Chinese cloud companies is expected to offset increased U.S. demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: SanDisk is focused on 8 data center customers, including 3 U.S. hyperscale companies seeking supply certainty through long-term contracts.
